articles.summary: Complete map of platform pages — play, create, economy, library, and community — now unified under the Forum hub.
articles.body_markdown:
# MasterNoder portal guide

This article lists every major page on the platform. **News, chat, podcast, rulebooks, documentation, paragraphs, and support** now live in the **Forum** (`/forum/`).

## Create
- **Generator** `/generator/` — AI video documentaries
- **Gallery** `/gallery/` — finished videos
- **Editor** `/editor/` — content tools
- **Podcast** `/forum#podcast` — channels, episodes, iPod-style player

## Play
- **Game** `/game/` — Hunters, walkthroughs, guides
- **Battle** `/battle/` — PvP and stats
- **Casino** `/casino/` — slots and tournaments
- **Battlegrounds** `/battlegrounds/`

## Account
- **Profile** `/profile/` — points, wallet, inventory
- **Shop** `/shop/` — MN2 purchases
- **Trophies** `/trophies/` — achievements and stories

## Platform
- **Lab** `/lab/` — experiments and roundtable
- **Debugger** `/debugger/` — diagnostics
- **Aggregator** `/aggregator/` — AI catalog
- **Exchange** `/exchange/` — crypto swap
- **Explorer** `/explorer/` — MN2 chain tools

## Forum hub (community & knowledge)
- **News** — platform announcements
- **Articles** — user-written posts
- **Chat** — AI + social room
- **Rulebooks** — compendium V1–V16
- **Paragraphs** — rights & citation rules
- **Documentation** — guides and FAQs
- **Support** — tickets and agent help
- **Social** — Discord, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat share
- **Wikipedia** — lookup summaries for research posts

## Legacy URLs
Old `/news`, `/chat`, `/podcast`, `/compendium` home pages redirect into Forum tabs. Deep links like `/compendium/rulebook-v9` still work.
